OGUN STATE (PSI 7.9): Gov. Abiodun Highlights ₦1bn Grants for Traders & Artisans at 2026 World Trade Day
LAGOS STATE (PSI 7.8): LASCOPA Issues MANCAP Logo Advisory; LASEMA Subdues Isheri Workshop Fire; Health District V Conducts Safety Training
RIVERS STATE (PSI 7.5): Gov. Fubara Appoints Eze Sergeant Chidi Awuse as Chairman, Rivers State Council of Traditional Rulers
EBONYI (PSI 9.3): Gov. Nwifuru transmitted an executive bill making kidnapping a capital offence to the House of Assembly following the murder of HRH Eze Francis Igwe.
FCT ABUJA (PSI 9.2): Minister Wike commissioned Dunamis pedestrian bridge on Airport Expressway with a 50% refund pledge and backed LGAN for the 2026 All Africa Challenge Trophy.
PLATEAU (PSI 9.1): Banned raw produce sales, launching processed potato branding, cold storage deployment, and a land committee for a Chinese-backed Trade Park.
ZAMFARA (PSI 8.8): EFCC boss commended Gov. Lawal; security neutralized 30 bandits in Bukuyum; and Gov. Lawal presented vehicles to 19 Emirs.
DELTA (PSI 8.5): Reduced legacy debt from ₦463bn to ₦63bn, targeting full clearance by Q1 2027 while advancing Ayakoromo Bridge and rural roads.
EDO (PSI 8.4): Mining Commissioner mandated equal 5% CDA split for Ikpoba/Oregbeni; Gov. Okpebholo met EU delegates on migration.
OYO (PSI 8.3): Gov. Makinde approved ₦4.6bn compensation for Phase 1 Circular Road landowners and directed fencing of the 75m corridor.
ONDO (PSI 8.3): Presented employment letters to 637 absorbed primary school teachers and set up a state burial panel for Pa Reuben Fasoranti.
ADAMAWA (PSI 8.2): Gov. Fintiri and associate donated ₦35m to FMC Mubi patients, while Rural Ministry charged staff on rules compliance.
AKWA IBOM (PSI 8.1): Gov. Eno approved a 13th-month pension bonus and ₦10k welfare, while appointing Mr. Aniefiok Johnson as Chief of Staff.
CROSS RIVER (PSI 8.0): Flagged off the 2026 Calabar Marathon and organized training for evaluators on the new CR-SUBEB Collect App.
OGUN (PSI 7.9): Marked World Trade Day, highlighting over ₦1bn in financial assistance provided to artisans, traders, and cooperatives.
LAGOS (PSI 7.8): LASCOPA issued MANCAP logo advisory; LASEMA contained Isheri workshop fire; and Health District V held pharmacy safety training.
RIVERS (PSI 7.5): Gov. Fubara approved the appointment of Eze Sergeant Chidi Awuse as Chairman of the Rivers State Council of Traditional Rulers.
